title: How Far Back a Low Income Premium Subsidy Award Reaches on a Ridgecrest Advantage Premium Account
content:
A low income premium subsidy awarded to a member of a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan reaches back over a number of coverage months, and that number is read from the low income premium subsidy credits standing on the premium account of the member's Stand-Alone Medicare Part D Prescription Drug Plans enrollment.

- Where at least 3 low income premium subsidy credits stand on that drug plan premium account, the award reaches back over 3 coverage months.
- Where at least 1 but fewer than 3 such credits stand on that account, the award reaches back over 1 coverage month.
- Where no such credit stands on that account, the award reaches back over 0 coverage months.

The credits counted are the low income premium subsidy credits on that drug plan premium account, and no other entry standing on it is counted.

| Low income premium subsidy credits on the drug plan premium account | Coverage months the award reaches back over |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 1 |
| 3 | 3 |
| 4 or more | 3 |

The step from 2 credits to 3 credits is the one that moves the reach-back from 1 coverage month to 3; a member with exactly 2 such credits stands on the same footing as a member with 1.
